actions.mechanism: Record presence separately from condition so counting cannot imply verified good condition.
actions.implementation: Create ten ID rows with presence, condition category, inspector, and timestamp. Default condition to unknown; remove the editable complete checkbox.
actions.check: Return ten counted, uninspected components: display ten present, ten condition unknown, and zero verified good.
actions.risk: Bulk entry could fabricate evidence; prohibit bulk verified-good updates.

actions.mechanism: Separate custody acceptance from inspection approval, preserving responsibility without inventing evidence.
actions.implementation: Show the kit, unresolved IDs, and current custodian. Incoming staff acknowledge custody; record both staff identities and transfer time without changing conditions.
actions.check: Transfer a counted-only return: the incoming custodian changes, while all ten conditions remain unknown and earlier records remain visible.
actions.risk: Unaccepted transfers need a named on-duty supervisor as escalation owner.

actions.action: Assign every missing component a recovery task
actions.mechanism: Turn absence into owned work rather than an unresolved warning.
actions.implementation: For each missing ID, require a named staff owner, next action, and due time. Offer actions such as checking the return station or contacting the borrower.
actions.check: Mark one ID missing; verify its task survives shift transfer and cannot close without a recorded outcome.
actions.risk: Task ownership must not imply borrower fault or automatic charges.

actions.action: Timebox handoff and defer unfinished inspection explicitly
actions.mechanism: Protect the three-minute limit by transferring unresolved work instead of rushing verification.
actions.implementation: At two minutes, stop new inspection work and summarize remaining unknown IDs. By three minutes, assign follow-up ownership and acknowledge custody.
actions.check: Run a timed handoff with all ten conditions unknown; finish within 180 seconds with every unresolved ID assigned.
actions.risk: Deferred inspection can accumulate; escalate overdue work to the shift supervisor.

actions.action: Separate custody received from ready to lend
actions.mechanism: Allow incomplete returns to be accepted without presenting them as cleared equipment.
actions.implementation: Use separate custody and readiness labels. Keep readiness pending while any component is missing or unknown; apply documented lending rules to verified condition categories.
actions.check: Accept a counted-only return: custody shows received, readiness stays pending, and the normal checkout path remains unavailable.
actions.risk: Pending kits reduce availability; display the blocking IDs and follow-up owner.

actions.action: Provide a kit-bound paper continuity record
actions.mechanism: Carry evidence through workstation outages without photographs, personal devices, or tracking hardware.
actions.implementation: Keep a numbered ten-ID form with the kit, including presence, condition, inspector, time, custody acceptance, and exception ownership. Reconcile it into the ledger afterward.
actions.check: Simulate an outage and shift change; incoming staff identify unknown conditions and missing-item owners from the form within three minutes.
actions.risk: Conflicting copies require one designated original and documented reconciliation.

actions.action: Prevent old inspections from clearing new returns
actions.mechanism: Scope evidence to each lending cycle so historical good condition cannot become current verification.
actions.implementation: Open a new return record with every presence and condition field unknown. Retain prior inspections as labeled history; require fresh evidence for current verification.
actions.check: Return a previously verified-good kit and record only its count: current conditions remain unknown while prior results remain accessible.
actions.risk: Cycle creation errors require correction history rather than silent overwriting.
